name: comp-131
title: Merge Strategy Split Button
blurb: Split button for selecting merge strategy with dropdown showing three options.
description: A stateful split button with selected merge strategy display and dropdown menu. Dropdown offers three options: Merge, Squash and merge, Rebase and merge with descriptions.
use_when: Letting users choose a merge strategy in pull request or version control interfaces.
avoid_when: When only one merge method is available.
a11y: Uses DropdownMenuRadioGroup for mutually exclusive selection. Descriptions help users understand each option.
